subtitle: Same distinction as T-SQL, different syntax

caption: CALL, not EXEC. Assignment uses :=. No @ prefix on variables.

eyebrow: A SQL UDF — one expression, no side effects
code:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION full_name(first_name VARCHAR, last_name VARCHAR)
RETURNS VARCHAR
LANGUAGE SQL
AS
$$
  first_name || ' ' || last_name
$$;

SELECT full_name(first_name, last_name) FROM customers;
caption: Maps directly onto a T-SQL scalar function used inline in a SELECT.
